9. A transformer's primary winding carries a current of $I_1=15000$ amperes and has a terminal voltage of $U_1=11000$ volts.
Its secondary winding carries a current of $I_2=1440$ amperes and has a terminal voltage of $U_2=110$ kilovolts.
Find the efficiency of the transformer.
